info.name: StyleMind Identity — Manage Addresses US-02.06
info.description: Address lifecycle, ownership, validation, lookup, auth and cleanup. Use dedicated fresh verified CUSTOMER accounts. No secrets or tokens are stored in this collection. Direct local Identity at {{baseUrl}}; no API Gateway. Authenticated requests set Authorization from run-scoped collection tokens in pre-request scripts, so an older environment token cannot override account A/B.

item.name: Capture A state before delete-default conflict

exec: const runToken=pm.collectionVariables.get("tokenA");if(!runToken)throw new Error("Missing run-scoped tokenA; run Login A/B first.");pm.request.headers.upsert({key:"Authorization",value:"Bearer "+runToken});

function canonical(rows){pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array");return rows.map(x=>{const y={};["address_id","label","recipient_name","recipient_phone","address_line","ward_code","is_default"].forEach(k=>{pm.expect(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(x,k),"response omitted "+k).to.eql(true);y[k]=x[k];});return y;}).sort((a,b)=>a.address_id.localeCompare(b.address_id));}
pm.test("snapshot has expected owner state",()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const xs=canonical(pm.response.json().addresses);pm.expect(xs).to.have.length(2);pm.expect(xs.filter(x=>x.is_default)).to.have.length(1);pm.expect(xs.find(x=>x.address_id===pm.collectionVariables.get("addressA2")).is_default).to.eql(true);pm.collectionVariables.set("addressConflictSnapshot",JSON.stringify(xs));});
